_source: Stack et al. 2020, Space Sci Rev 216:127, Table 2 (type locations). Table column is headed lat/lon but values are written LON, LAT. Descriptions are condensed from the table. stay_min is an ASSUMPTION (editable).

start.name: Octavia E. Butler landing site
start.source: Perseverance landing site coordinates supplied by user

targets.name: Delta blocky
targets.description: Intermediate-toned blocky deposit forming steep-sided, boulder-shedding elongate ridges on the delta's upper surface

targets.name: Delta thinly layered
targets.description: Stratified sequence of <1 m thick alternating light and dark planar bands; locally deformed
targets.interpretation: Fine-grained prodelta or distal lacustrine deposits

targets.name: Delta thickly layered
targets.description: Light-toned, resistant strata up to several metres thick
targets.interpretation: Channel lobes at the toe of the delta slope, or delta plain alluvial/floodplain deposits

targets.name: Delta truncated curvilinear layered
targets.description: Decimetre-scale sets of alternating light/dark layers that truncate against one another over tens of metres
targets.interpretation: Laterally accreting point bars, or subaqueous channel-levee complexes

targets.name: Delta layered rough
targets.description: Light-toned, parallel, m-thick stratified deposit northeast of the western delta

targets.name: Margin fractured
targets.description: Light-toned fractured bedrock on the inner crater margin, between about -2440 m and -2190 m (south of Neretva Vallis)
targets.interpretation: Unspecified tephra or marginal lacustrine deposit

targets.name: Crater floor fractured 1
targets.description: Massive, light-toned fractured and blocky bedrock on the crater floor below -2530 m elevation
targets.interpretation: Unspecific tephra, airfall, aeolian, or lacustrine deposit

targets.name: Crater floor fractured rough
targets.description: Light- to medium-toned, rough, boulder-producing, highly crater-retaining unit; polygonal fracture networks are common
targets.interpretation: Unspecified tephra, airfall, aeolian, or lacustrine deposit
